title: Reorganize libsufr and the CLI without changing behavior
body:
libsufr and the sufr CLI work, but each job is spread over several files and several copies of the same decision. The branch `refactor` (from e8655c9) regroups them without changing what a user or a `.sufr` file sees.

What exists today, by file:

| file | lines | jobs |
|---|---|---|
| `libsufr/src/types.rs` | 680 | format constants, `SeedMask`, `SuffixSortType`, sealed `Int`, the option and result structs, `Comparison`, `SufrMetadata` |
| `libsufr/src/sufr_builder.rs` | 1396 | `SuffixArrayBuilder`, partition/sort/merge, header writer (865-964), `ScratchBuffer`, `PartitioningAlphabet` |
| `libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs` | 1687 | header reader (139-272), text access, `~/.sufr` locate cache, subsampling, search orchestration, `extract`/`locate` shaping, `list` printing |
| `libsufr/src/sufr_search.rs` | 368 | binary search over the suffix array; storage mode picked by `is_empty()` on slices |
| `libsufr/src/suffix_array.rs` | 373 | `SuffixArrayTrait`, `SuffixArray32`, `SuffixArray64` (identical), the `SuffixArray` facade |
| `libsufr/src/lcp.rs` | 170 | byte-slice LCP with an AVX2 path; only the builder calls it |
| `libsufr/src/file_access.rs` | 223 | typed `FileAccess<T>` reader, iterator, unix/windows `write_at` and `read_exact_at` |
| `libsufr/src/util.rs` | 283 | `find_lcp_full_offset`, `read_sequence_file`, `read_text_length`, two unsafe native-endian casts |
| `sufr/src/lib.rs` | 800 | clap types, six handlers, and logic that belongs in the library (locate grouping 480-526, extract coordinates 385-405, summarize rows 569-642, query-file parsing 439-457) |

The same decision is made in several places. The `.sufr` header is written, read and parsed a third time in `read_text_length`. The sort-type `match` appears in five places. Storage mode is chosen by `is_empty()` in `sufr_search.rs` and again in `sufr_file.rs` 296-338. Four routines compute an LCP with three different contracts. The query methods are copied across `SufrFile`, `SuffixArrayTrait`, `SuffixArray32`, `SuffixArray64` and `SuffixArray`.

## Proposal

Frozen, and checked by tests before anything moves:

- CLI: every flag, stdout byte for byte, stderr lines, exit codes.
- File: `.sufr` bytes at `OUTFILE_VERSION` 6, and the fixtures in `data/`.
- Results: counts, ranks, positions and extracts for any input.

The libsufr Rust API may change freely.

Target shape of libsufr, six modules:

| module | job |
|---|---|
| `format.rs` | the `.sufr` layout: one `Header` struct, one read, one write, named offsets |
| `io.rs` | `FileAccess<T>` and its iterator, the positioned read/write shim, the two native-endian slice casts |
| `lcp.rs` | one LCP routine family, aware of mask and max query length, AVX2 path kept |
| `build.rs` | `SuffixArrayBuilder`, partition/sort/merge, FASTA reading |
| `index.rs` | `Index<T>` = header + text + suffixes, each stored in memory, subsampled or on disk; the `~/.sufr` locate cache |
| `search.rs` | `search(&Index<T>, &[u8])` returning `Hits`; count, ranks, locate and extract are methods on `Hits` |

`lib.rs` keeps only `pub enum SuffixArray { U32(Index<u32>), U64(Index<u64>) }` and re-exports. `types.rs`, `util.rs`, `sufr_search.rs`, `suffix_array.rs`, `subsample_tests.rs`, `SuffixArrayTrait`, `SuffixArray32`, `SuffixArray64` and every Options/Result struct go away. The element width stays a type parameter because the on-disk layout needs it. One two-variant enum erases it at the boundary.

Configuration principle: one home per knob, and no function takes a config struct.

- build: `SuffixArrayBuilder::from_fasta(path)` or `from_text(..)`, then `.dna(..)`, `.partitions(n)`, `.scratch_in_memory()`, `.write_lcp()`, `.sort(Sort::Full | MaxQueryLen(n) | Mask(m))`, `.write(path)`.
- open: `SuffixArray::open(path)` or `open_with(path, Load::{Memory, Subsampled(mql), Disk})`. `max_query_len` and low-memory mode are open-time properties.
- query: `sa.search(b"ACG")` returns `Hits`, then `count()`, `ranks()`, `locate()`, `extract(before, after)`.
- CLI: `-l`, `-v` and `-m` map onto open options. Flags and output stay the same.

Guiding principle, from Jack: performance first, then simple, concise, non-clever, readable code. As little code as possible, but never at the cost of readability. Several simple lines beat one confusing line.

The `search-api` branch is not merged. Its query model is the inspiration for `search.rs`, not a spec. Names chosen here are provisional. Bugs the survey found are tracked as separate issues and are not fixed during the reorganization.

## Cost

Each step is one commit with the full suite green. The seven children below run in order.
close_reason: All six code steps landed on branch refactor, d17bed2..ad1a659, each with the full suite green and a differential sweep against the previous commit. The skill step is closed separately. Review by Jack is pending.
